strings.zh: 在这个战斗轮盘里{NEWLINE}一边应付众多的活动,{CLEAR}一边战斗看能撑到什么地步。{CLEAR}根据战斗之前停住的轮盘,{CLEAR}战斗可能变成对你有利,{CLEAR}也可能变成对你不利。{SCROLL}同时,在战斗轮盘里{NEWLINE}挑战开始之前,{CLEAR}可以把精灵带的道具{CLEAR}暂时寄存在这里。{SCROLL}如果成功取得7连胜的话{CLEAR}会获得ＢＰ值！{SCROLL}另外,想要临时中断挑战的时候{SCROLL}一定要保存好记录,不然就{NEWLINE}不能从中断的地方接着玩！{SCROLL}请一定要注意！{SCROLL}
strings.en: At the Battle Arcade, you may take a{NEWLINE}Single or Double Battle challenge.{SCROLL}Here, a game board is activated{NEWLINE}before every match.{SCROLL}Depending on what comes up on the{NEWLINE}game board, an event takes place.{SCROLL}Some events will be good for the{NEWLINE}challenger, while others won’t be.{SCROLL}The objective is to keep a winning{NEWLINE}streak alive as long as possible.{SCROLL}During your challenge, any items held by{NEWLINE}your Pokémon will be kept in storage.{SCROLL}If you manage to win seven matches in{NEWLINE}a row, you will earn Battle Points (BP).{SCROLL}If you want to interrupt your{NEWLINE}challenge, please save the game.{SCROLL}If you don’t save, you will be{NEWLINE}disqualified from your challenge.{SCROLL}Please be aware of that!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 欢迎光临战斗轮盘！{SCROLL}我向您介绍可以和{NEWLINE}朋友一起玩的多人战！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Welcome to the Battle Arcade!{SCROLL}I am your guide to the Multi Battle{NEWLINE}challenge.{SCROLL}Please be aware that this challenge{NEWLINE}requires two Trainers.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 要挑战战斗轮盘多人战吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Would you like to take the Battle{NEWLINE}Arcade Multi Battle challenge?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 在这里两人可以联手合作与{NEWLINE}训练师进行多人战！{SCROLL}战斗之前要挑战轮盘,{SCROLL}轮盘停止后,{NEWLINE}会有很多各种活动发生。{SCROLL}活动会很大程度地改变{NEWLINE}战斗的走向！{SCROLL}当完成７个小游戏之后{NEWLINE}将获赠ＢＰ值！{SCROLL}而且,挑战之前可以在{NEWLINE}战斗轮盘寄存{CLEAR}精灵的道具。{CLEAR}另外,在多人战不能临时中断！{SCROLL}
strings.en: You may team up with a friend for a{NEWLINE}Multi Battle challenge.{SCROLL}Here, a game board is activated{NEWLINE}before every match.{SCROLL}Depending on what comes up on the{NEWLINE}game board, an event takes place.{SCROLL}The events may have great impact on{NEWLINE}the match’s outcome, good or bad.{SCROLL}The objective is to keep a winning{NEWLINE}streak alive as long as possible.{SCROLL}During your challenge, any items held by{NEWLINE}your Pokémon will be kept in storage.{SCROLL}If you manage to win seven matches in{NEWLINE}a row, you will earn Battle Points (BP).{SCROLL}Please note: a Battle Arcade Multi{NEWLINE}Battle challenge can’t be interrupted.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 轮盘就如人生一般,{SCROLL}不停旋转,{NEWLINE}命运周而复始。{SCROLL}你听懂我这句听起来有点深度{NEWLINE}但其实一点深度也没有的话了吗？
strings.en: The game board is like your life.{SCROLL}It goes round and round{NEWLINE}as your fortune goes up and down...{CLEAR}How did that sound?{SCROLL}It almost made some kind of sense,{NEWLINE}didn’t it?

strings.zh: 在精灵对战中,{NEWLINE}运气也是一个非常重要的因素。{SCROLL}你只要玩玩这轮盘,{NEWLINE}就能深刻理解{CLEAR}我这句话的含义了。
strings.en: There’s an aspect of luck in{NEWLINE}Pokémon battles...{SCROLL}The Battle Arcade reminds me of that,{NEWLINE}decisively. Very decisively...

strings.zh: 你认为是什么主导着这里？{NEWLINE}力量？{CLEAR}智慧？{CLEAR}运气？{SCROLL}都不是,{NEWLINE}我个人感觉,{CLEAR}最为主要的,{CLEAR}其实是你要想得开⋯⋯
strings.en: What quality is most needed here?{NEWLINE}Is it strength?{CLEAR}Wisdom?{CLEAR}Luck?{CLEAR}No. The answer is...flexibility.{CLEAR}That’s what my gut tells me.

strings.zh: 你晓得什么叫「目押」吗？{NEWLINE}其实就是你要盯住{CLEAR}想让轮盘停下的时候按下按钮。{SCROLL}这个也是需要眼疾手快的,{NEWLINE}３０秒过后,{CLEAR}轮盘会自动停下来。
strings.en: Do you know what I mean by{NEWLINE}“stop on the spot”?{SCROLL}It’s the skill of stopping the{NEWLINE}game board at the right time!{SCROLL}But, remember...{CLEAR}If you don’t stop it in 30 seconds,{NEWLINE}it will stop by itself.

strings.zh: 我原本想用我那只花了{NEWLINE}巨大心血培养的精灵前来一战,{CLEAR}结果和对手的精灵交换之后{CLEAR}反倒成为了我的对手！{SCROLL}看来我还得{NEWLINE}重新再考虑一套战术。
strings.en: I thought I was fully prepared with my{NEWLINE}prized Pokémon, but I had to swap them{CLEAR}and use my opponent’s instead!{CLEAR}I need to rethink all my strategies.

strings.zh: 我那只以{NEWLINE}攻击力见长的精灵{CLEAR}被对方的速度给压制住了。{SCROLL}下次,{NEWLINE}我也要弄只速度快的精灵{CLEAR}前来挑战。
strings.en: I chose Pokémon that are good at{NEWLINE}attacking.{CLEAR}But my opponent went for speed!{SCROLL}Next time, I’ll try Pokémon with{NEWLINE}superior speed.

strings.zh: 掌握好目押的技巧{NEWLINE}的确能给自己带来更大的胜算,{SCROLL}但是自己将命运交给轮盘,{NEWLINE}而不是依靠自己的那种感觉{CLEAR}也别有一番风味⋯⋯
strings.en: There are advantages to be gained from{NEWLINE}“stop on the spot” skills!{SCROLL}But there’s a lot of fun in letting the{NEWLINE}unknown hand of luck decide...

strings.zh: 越强的人来玩,{NEWLINE}轮盘出的点数也越好。{SCROLL}难道⋯⋯{NEWLINE}这轮盘通人性吗？
strings.en: The game board shows better choices{NEWLINE}the greater the wins you achieve...{SCROLL}Could this board be alive...?

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{NEWLINE}地面类型的精灵{CLEAR}不会受到麻痹,{CLEAR}去把这事通知给大伙吧。
strings.en: Did you figure this one out?{SCROLL}Paralyzing events here won’t{NEWLINE}affect Ground-type Pokémon.{SCROLL}You should tell everybody!

strings.zh: 我告诉你个秘密,{NEWLINE}像毒或者冰冻状态{CLEAR}可以根据精灵的类型和特性{CLEAR}去防范它,{CLEAR}长见识了吧！
strings.en: I’ll tell you something.{SCROLL}Poisoning or freezing events can be{NEWLINE}made ineffective.{SCROLL}...If the Pokémon’s type or ability{NEWLINE}protects it from such status problems.{SCROLL}Might be worth knowing!
